args.body:
Hi Sam,

Following up on the Data Export customer incident. To help us investigate and resolve this, could you please provide the following diagnostics:

1. Error messages or stack traces observed during the data export failure
2. Timestamps of when the issue occurred
3. Steps to reproduce (export configuration, file format, data size, etc.)
4. Any relevant logs from your environment
5. Whether the issue is reproducible or intermittent

Please share these as soon as possible so we can prioritize resolution. Thanks!

Best regards
